adjustments.note: public split table; stock dividends excluded (price return); bond-fund income estimated from Treasury yields

conventions.execution: signal at the close of t, traded at the close of t+1
conventions.inception: first trade's cost is in the first return
conventions.sharpe: excess over the accrued cash rate
conventions.window: every variant on the same dates after warm-up

trims.basis: example: model-book drift since the last rebalance, not your holdings

policies.hedge.tlt.v2: Hold TLT at the minimum-variance ratio (capped at 1.0x) only while the stock-bond state is 'hedging' and, when the research has a reliable inflation line, 36-month inflation is below it. The state enters 'hedging' when the correlation is at or below -0.10 and leaves only when it rises above 0.
policies.size.equity.v2: Equity scale = the smallest of: volatility target / forecast volatility, the drawdown cap, and max gross. Quarter Kelly is reported beside it as an edge check: the excess return that would justify this size.
policies.limits.portfolio.v1: After the hedge is added, equity plus bond notional may not exceed max total gross; if it does, equity and hedge are scaled down together. Option premium is capped as a share of NAV.

data_quality.rule: spike: |r| > 8 robust sd, reversed >= 70% next day; stale: 5+ unchanged closes while the market moved
